items.rationale: Dismantling and refitting to place the drying equipment is part of technical drying (5.2.7). Priced at the case 46 level of about 84-95.
Technical drying is covered (5.2.7), and 7 invoiced days sits within the roughly two-week drying period described. Priced at about 45/day from the prior.
Under 7.4.4 a surcharge is paid only with an itemised material list, and the description calls this one unexplained. Utilities and ancillary equipment are also included in the dryer charge (5.2.7).
Mineral-wool shell is the standard grade (7.14c) for reinstating the pipe insulation, so it is covered. Priced at the prior of about 26.
Removal and disposal is reimbursed once per event, and only the first of several charges is paid (5.2.1). This drying invoice comes first.
Re-levelling the substrate is part of making good (5.2.6). Priced at the case 46 level.
Substrate preparation within the damage area is plausibly covered, but it may overlap with the levelling and labour lines. Estimated at a moderate per-m² rate.
Creating the access opening needed to reach the damage is covered under opening up (5.2.6). Small charge.
90x90 is within the commercially usual standard threshold (7.14d), so replacement tiles are covered. Priced at about the case 46 per-m² level for roughly 4 m².
These exceed the 90x90 standard threshold, and 3.5(f) allows no payment at all for such items. They also duplicate the tiling in line 9 (3.5(d)).
Standard sanitary silicone for the reinstated tiling is covered. Priced at about 13/m from the prior.
Travel is paid once per contractor per document (7.4.2), and this is the only such charge on the tiling invoice. Priced at the case 46 level.
Labour is paid at locally customary rates (7.4.1). Case 46 showed 14 hrs at >=1260 for similar tiling work.

items.description: Remove drywall and insulation in basement
items.rationale: Opening up and debris removal within the damage area is covered (5.2.6). Case 46 priced drywall removal at 44-55 and insulation removal at 44-48 as separate lines; combined here.
Removing damp plaster in the basement damage area is covered. Only 1 pc is invoiced, so the line is set between the prior's 29 per pc and the case 46 total for 3 m².
No damage was established in the attic and the description calls this work unrelated (3.5(b)), so it is excluded.
This duplicates the drying contractor's disposal charge, and only the first such charge is reimbursed (5.2.1, 3.5(d)).
